title: CaPa: Efficient 4K Textured Mesh Generation
heroTitle: CaPa: Carve-n-Paint Synthesis for Efficient 4K Textured Mesh Generation
overview: CaPa addressed the Janus problem in image-to-3D generation with Spatially Decoupled Attention, preventing duplicated features and conflicting details across generated views.

It was the first image-to-3D system to generate 4K textures. The result demonstrated the product potential of native 3D generation inside the company and became a turning point toward the in-house VARCO 3D service.
contributions: Designed Spatially Decoupled Attention to resolve cross-view Janus artifacts.
Built the Carve-n-Paint pipeline for complete 4K textured meshes in under 30 seconds.
Established the research direction that developed into VARCO 3D.
